questions.question: Find the name and location of the stadiums which some concerts happened in the years of both 2014 and 2015.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2014 INTERSECT SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2015

questions.question: Find the first name and age of students who have a pet.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fname ,  T1.age FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid

questions.question: Find the model of the car whose weight is below the average weight.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Weight  <  (SELECT avg(Weight) FROM CARS_DATA)

questions.question: Find the make and production time of the cars that were produced in the earliest year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Make ,  T1.Year FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T1.Year  =  (SELECT min(YEAR) FROM CARS_DATA);

questions.question: Which distinct car models are the produced after 1980?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.model FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.model  =  T2.model JOIN CARS_DATA AS T3 ON T2.MakeId  =  T3.id WHERE T3.year  >  1980;

questions.question: What model has the most different versions?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Model FROM CAR_NAMES GROUP BY Model ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many cars have more than 4 cylinders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE Cylinders  >  4;

questions.question: What are the names and ids of all makers with more than 3 models?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName ,  T1.Id FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >  3;

questions.question: Which city has most number of departing flights?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.City FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.City ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many flights land in Aberdeen or Abilene?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Flights AS T1 JOIN Airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.city  =  "Aberdeen" OR T2.city  =  "Abilene"

questions.question: Which cities do more than one employee under age 30 come from?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT city FROM employee WHERE age  <  30 GROUP BY city HAVING count(*)  >  1

questions.question: For each shop, return the number of employees working there and the name of the shop.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  t2.name FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id GROUP BY t2.name

questions.question: What are all different template ids used for documents, and how many times were each of them used?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT template_id ,  count(*) FROM Documents GROUP BY template_id

questions.question: How many templates do we have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Templates

questions.question: What are the ids of templates with template type code PP or PPT?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT template_id FROM Templates WHERE template_type_code  =  "PP" OR template_type_code  =  "PPT"

questions.question: Return the template type code of the template that is used by a document named Data base.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.template_type_code FROM Templates AS T1 JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.template_id  =  T2.template_id WHERE T2.document_name  =  "Data base"

questions.question: What are the details for the paragraph that includes the text 'Korea ' ?
questions.gold_sql: select other_details from paragraphs where paragraph_text like 'korea'

questions.question: What are the paragraph texts for the document with the name 'Customer reviews'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.paragraph_text FROM Paragraphs AS T1 JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.document_id  =  T2.document_id WHERE T2.document_name  =  "Customer reviews"

questions.question: For each hometown, how many teachers are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Hometown ,  COUNT(*) FROM teacher GROUP BY Hometown

questions.question: Find the name and membership level of the visitors whose membership level is higher than 4, and sort by their age from old to young.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  Level_of_membership FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership  >  4 ORDER BY age DESC

questions.question: List the name and tonnage ordered by in descending alphaetical order for the names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  tonnage FROM ship ORDER BY name DESC

questions.question: What are the notes of the death events which has substring 'East'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT note FROM death WHERE note LIKE '%East%'

questions.question: What are all the course names of the courses which ever have students enrolled in?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id

questions.question: What are the last name of the students who live in North Carolina but have not registered in any degree programs?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id

questions.question: Whose permanent address is different from his or her current address? List his or her first name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE current_address_id != permanent_address_id

questions.question: What are the different addresses that have students living there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT current_address_id) FROM Students

questions.question: List the title of all cartoons in alphabetical order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM Cartoon ORDER BY title

questions.question: List each language and the number of TV Channels using it.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LANGUAGE ,  count(*) FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY LANGUAGE

questions.question: which countries' tv channels are not playing any cartoon written by Todd Casey?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country FROM TV_Channel EXCEPT SELECT T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.written_by  =  'Todd Casey'

questions.question: What are the names of poker players?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID

questions.question: Return the nationalities for which there are two or more people.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality FROM people GROUP BY Nationality HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2

questions.question: Of all the contestants who got voted, what is the contestant number and name of the contestant who got least votes?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.contestant_number , T1.contestant_name FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number GROUP BY T1.contestant_number ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the name, population and expected life length of asian country with the largest area?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  Population ,  LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia" ORDER BY SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which cities are in European countries where English is not the official language?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN city AS T2 ON T2.CountryCode  =  T1.Code WHERE T1.Continent  =  'Europe' AND T1.Name NOT IN (SELECT T3.Name FROM country AS T3 JOIN countrylanguage AS T4 ON T3.Code  =  T4.CountryCode WHERE T4.IsOfficial  =  'T' AND T4.Language  =  'English')

questions.question: Give the names of countries that are in Europe and have a population equal to 80000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE continent  =  "Europe" AND Population  =  "80000"

questions.question: Count the number of different nationalities of conductors.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Nationality) FROM conductor

questions.question: List the name of the conductor with the most years of work.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the names and grades of each high schooler.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  grade FROM Highschooler

questions.question: Show me all grades that have at least 4 students.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT grade FROM Highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING count(*)  >=  4

questions.question: Return the names of friends of the high school student Kyle.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id JOIN Highschooler AS T3 ON T1.friend_id  =  T3.id WHERE T2.name  =  "Kyle"

questions.question: What are the names of high schoolers who have a grade of over 5 and have 2 or more friends?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.grade  >  5 GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: Which first names are used for professionals or owners but are not used as dog names?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Professionals UNION SELECT first_name FROM Owners EXCEPT SELECT name FROM Dogs

questions.question: Which professionals have done at least two treatments? List the professional's id, role, and first name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.role_code ,  T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: Return the first name, last name and email of the owners living in a state whose name contains the substring 'North'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

questions.question: Count the number of dogs of an age below the average.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Dogs WHERE age  <  ( SELECT avg(age) FROM Dogs )

questions.question: How many professionals did not operate any treatment on dogs?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN ( SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments )

questions.question: What are the dog name, age and weight of the dogs that were abandoned? Note that 1 stands for yes, and 0 stands for no in the tables.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  age ,  weight FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn  =  1

questions.question: List each charge type and its amount.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT charge_type ,  charge_amount FROM Charges

questions.question: What is the charge amount of the most expensive charge type?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT max(charge_amount) FROM Charges

questions.question: List the name of singers in ascending order of net worth.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC
